about_the_game:
Hey there!

Nice that you found your way here. This Supporter Pack DLC adds a few extras to Step Away, but more than anything, it gives you a chance to support our work. We wanted to keep the main app free, so this felt like the right approach. If you enjoy what we’ve made, it would mean a lot if you grab this DLC so we can keep creating more content like this in the future.

What’s included in the DLC?

This pack comes with three small cosmetic additions:

  • A cute bird companion that can be toggled on and off in the hat menu

  • A peaceful night theme of the background

  • A spelunker’s hat with a headlamp that lights up when the night theme is active

They’re just little extras, but we hope they bring you joy. And if you’ve got any feedback, we’d love to hear from you on our Discord :)

Julian & Basti
